pages.text: The mod introduces the possibility of using vanilla and $(l:utility/dyeing_bone_meal)Dyeing$() Bone Meal on some plants that did not have this function in vanilla.$(br2)The latter can be used on a mod plants to grow up in the color of this bone meal.$(br)

$(br)The plants you can now use bone meal on:$(br)$(li)Cactus,$(li)Sugar cane,$(li)Water Lily,$(li)Vines,$(li)Little Flowers except Wither Rose$(br2)And many from complementary mods. It is also possible to use it on Podzol, Mycelium and Soul Sand blocks.$(br)
